summary: Overrides are raw CLI strings that skipped the loader substitution pass, so {posargs}, {env:VAR} and {env_name} arrived literally. Added Loader.substitute (raises NotImplementedError, docstring styled after build) in src/tox/config/loader/api.py, plus `import inspect`; Loader.load now computes delay_replace = inspect.isclass(of_type) and issubclass(of_type, SetEnv) and uses override.value unchanged when delay_replace or conf is None, else self.substitute(override.value, conf, args) before _STR_CONVERT.to. Implemented IniLoader.substitute (ReplaceReferenceIni) and TomlLoader.substitute (TomlReplaceLoader) after their build methods. Added docs/changelog/4047.bugfix.rst and a 'Substitutions inside an override' subsection (versionadded 4.61, posargs example, ini-spelling note) in docs/reference/config.rst. Check command passed: 33 passed.
concerns: substitute is not wrapped in HandledError the way build's replacer is, so a bad override substitution raises an unhandled error
docs subsection was placed before 'Escaping dots in override keys' rather than at the very end of the override docs
